title: Fractions Addition - Level 4: Word Problems
description: Solve real-world problems involving fraction addition

questions.question: Sarah ate 1/4 of a pizza and her brother ate 2/4 of the same pizza. How much pizza did they eat together?
A recipe calls for 1/2 cup of flour and 1/4 cup of sugar. How many cups of ingredients is that total?
John ran 2 1/2 miles on Monday and 1 1/2 miles on Tuesday. How many miles did he run total?
questions.explanation: Add whole numbers: 2+1=3. Add fractions: 1/2+1/2=1. Total: 4 miles

questions.question: A baker used 2/3 kg of flour for bread and 1/6 kg for cookies. How much flour did he use total?
In a class, 1/3 of students play football and 1/2 play basketball. What fraction plays either sport? (Assume no one plays both)
